newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Continue narrowing to US.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Continue narrowing to US.

text.p: Australian bonds outperformed U.S. debt as the local market prepared itself for a bond friendly Federal budget next week.

U.S. Treasuries, meanwhile, weakened in Tokyo in reaction to a fall in the U.S. dollar and ahead of the first leg of the quarterly refunding auctions later on Tuesday, which starts with US$17.0 billion of three-year notes.
Australian bonds also outpaced Canadian debt, despite a further rally there on waning concerns of a possible U.S. rate hike and continued strength in the Canadian dollar.

However, long-dated spreads to New Zealand widened after its first quarter labour force report showed 0.1 percent negative growth and a rise to 6.4 percent in unemployment, confirming the market's recent easing bias.
